title: Diplomatic language
description: Soften disagreement and make polite suggestions in sensitive discussions.

introduction.headline: Disagree without conflict
introduction.body: Use hedging, polite questions, and careful wording to keep conversations constructive.
introduction.bodyIt: Usa attenuazioni, domande cortesi e formulazioni attente per mantenere le conversazioni costruttive.

vocabulary.example: A diplomatic reply avoided an argument.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Una risposta diplomatica ha evitato una discussione.
Mantieni il feedback costruttivo e specifico.

options: I wonder whether we might consider another approach.
exercises.answer: I wonder whether we might consider another approach.

exercises.prompt: Would it be ____ to postpone the decision?
exercises.promptIt: Completa: Would it be ____ to postpone the decision?
exercises.explanation: Would it be possible is a polite request form.

exercises.prompt: What does diplomatic language help keep?
exercises.promptIt: Cosa aiuta a mantenere il linguaggio diplomatico?
exercises.explanation: Diplomatic wording reduces conflict and keeps talk useful.

review.tip: Rewrite one blunt disagreement as a polite suggestion.
